extracted.intended_audience: beat sports journalists, broadcasters, and media covering NBA team games (press/media members)
extracted.subtask_description: Operational media/press guidelines for covering NBA team games: arena directions, media entrance and parking, will-call/credentials, media center services, practice/shootaround access, and media contact lists.

rubrics_metrics.name: Media entrance location
rubrics_metrics.description: Each venue specifies a dedicated media entrance (example: Golden 1 Center — Media Entrance: 7th and David J. Stern Walk; Scotiabank Arena — North staff entrance (northwest corner); Delta Center — Employee and Media Entrance; Frost Bank Center — Northwest Media Entrance).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Media should use the designated media entrance noted for the arena. Signage or venue directions are provided (e.g., York Street/Raptors Way side for Scotiabank Arena). Follow venue-specific instructions for entry and staff directions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Will call / press will call location
rubrics_metrics.description: Will call windows or press will call are located at or inside the venue's media/employee entrance (example: Golden 1 Center — WILL CALL WINDOW: 7th and David J. Stern Walk; Delta Center — Media will call is located inside the Employee and Media Entrance on the south side of the arena along 100 South near Door 9).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reporters should pick up credentials at the specified will call/press will call location; venues list exact corner/entrance intersections to find the window quickly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Press credentials availability time
rubrics_metrics.description: Press credentials availability windows are specified by venue (example: Press credentials are available two hours before game tipoff at Delta Center).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Media must arrive within the stated credential distribution window (commonly two hours before tipoff for the listed venue). Confirm times with team PR in advance if unsure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Media parking: reserved lots vs. none
rubrics_metrics.description: Venue media-parking policies vary: some arenas provide reserved media lots or a designated media gate (example: Golden 1 Center — reserved media lot on corner of 7th and J under 24 Hour Fitness; Frost Bank Center — enter Gate D for media lot); other downtown arenas note 'PRESS PARKING: None' and advise pay lots nearby (example: Scotiabank Arena and Delta Center mention no press parking and recommend nearby pay facilities).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Check the venue-specific parking instructions in advance; if a reserved media lot is provided, use the stated gate/approach (e.g., enter Gate D). If no press parking, plan for commercial/pay lots and allow extra time.

rubrics_metrics.name: Media center / media room services and access
rubrics_metrics.description: Venues describe media center locations and services (example: Hot Rod Hundley Media Center at Delta Center is on level one in hallway by room 159A; services include a media workroom, dining area and broadcast interview room).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Media centers are accessible from the venue's employee/media entrance; signage directs to elevators or stairs. Use the media center for workspace, dining, and interviews as permitted; confirm access policies with team PR.

rubrics_metrics.name: Gameday shootaround and practice access policy
rubrics_metrics.description: Shootarounds and practices have venue-specific access rules (example: Jazz home practice time normally 11 a.m.; gameday shootarounds are at Zions Bank Basketball Campus and closed to media; media availability and b-roll opportunities open after shootaround; non-game day practices are also held at the practice facility — contact Jazz PR to confirm).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assume shootarounds may be closed to media unless otherwise stated; media should contact team PR to confirm practice times/access and to arrange post-shootaround availability or b-roll.

rubrics_metrics.name: Directions from nearest airport / venue approach guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: Each venue provides driving directions from the local airport or key approach routes (examples include step-by-step directions from Sacramento Intl Airport to Golden 1 Center; from Pearson International Airport to Scotiabank Arena; from Salt Lake International Airport to Delta Center; from San Antonio International Airport to Frost Bank Center).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the provided airport-to-arena directions to plan travel and parking approach; note downtown venues may have multiple recommended parking options and reserved media lots identified in the directions section.

rubrics_metrics.name: Team media relations and contact lists
rubrics_metrics.description: Teams supply named media-relations contacts (PR staff, vice presidents, managers) plus lists of writers regularly assigned to the club, broadcasters, radio/television contacts, and wire service contacts (with phone, email, and sometimes social handles).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the provided PR contacts to confirm credentialing, media access, interview availability, and any last-minute logistics. The guide lists local beat writers and broadcast partners for outreach and verification.
